description:
Use this when the user asks whether and when an Indian company paid or declared a dividend, or about its dividend yield.

Returns each cash dividend with its ex-date, type and amount per share, the total for the last twelve months with the yield and payout ratio on it, and totals by financial year (April to March). `years` (1 to 15, default 5) sets how far back. The list includes dividends announced with an ex-date still to come. For splits and bonuses use get_corporate_actions.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_dividends
title: Dividend history
